decisions.reason: The Big Block pool target and draw condition do not change the independently defined Small Block prize mechanism; its own $7,200 trigger is already represented.
Changing the Big Block pool trigger does not alter the separately represented ticket eligibility, burn, reset, or carry-forward rules.
The Big Block pool target and draw condition leave the manual prize-claim mode unchanged.
The Big Block draw trigger does not change the recipient or the numbers of Small and Big Block tickets issued for a referral mint.
The Big Block trigger change does not alter the requirement to display both ticket counters and permanent badges in NFT metadata.
The Big Block pool target does not change the one-ticket allocation to a random existing NFT when no referral code is used.
The Big Block pool target and draw condition do not change the automatic $10 coded-referral commission.
